PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_TransformerTypCommon
PropertySetDef.Definition: Definition from IAI: An inductive stationary device that transfers electrical energy from one circuit to another.

PropertyDef.Name: PrimaryVoltage
PropertyDef.Definition: IEC def. Needed. Nominal Primary Voltage is the voltage that are going to be transformed and runs into the transformer on primary side.

PropertyDef.Name: SecondaryVoltage
PropertyDef.Definition: IEC def, needed.Nominal Secondary Voltage is the voltage that has been transformed and is running out of the transformer on secondary side.

PropertyDef.Name: PrimaryCurrent
PropertyDef.Definition: Nominal Primary Current is the curent that is going to be transformed and runs into the transformer on primary side.

PropertyDef.Name: SecondaryCurrent
PropertyDef.Definition: Nominal Secondary Current is the curent that has been transformed and is running out of the transformer on secondary side.

PropertyDef.Name: PrimaryFrequency
PropertyDef.Definition: Nominal Primary Frequency is the frequency that is going to be transformed and runs into the transformer on primary side.

PropertyDef.Name: SecondaryFrequency
PropertyDef.Definition: Nominal Secondary Frequency is the frequency that has been transformed and is running out of the transformer on secondary side.

PropertyDef.Name: PrimaryApparentPower
PropertyDef.Definition: IEC def, needed.Nominal Primary apparent is the power in VA (volt ampere) that has been transformed and runs into the transformer on primary side.

PropertyDef.Name: SecondaryApparentPower
PropertyDef.Definition: IEC def, needed.Nominal Secondary apparent power is the power in VA (volt ampere) that has been transformed and are running out of the transformer on secondary side.

PropertyDef.Name: MaximumApparentPower
PropertyDef.Definition: IEC def, needed. Nominal maximum apparent power/capacity in VA (volt ampere).

PropertyDef.Name: SecondaryCurrentType
PropertyDef.Definition: A list of the secondary current types that can result from transformer output
